verdict.rationale: Stable ships embedded AI features: an "AI-powered inbox" that automatically sorts and routes mail, plus AI document summaries of mail contents, listed on the pricing page. These let users hand some mail triage work to AI, but nothing shows a built-in assistant that users can direct or delegate arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: a conversational or agentic assistant inside the product, user-directed task delegation (e.g., forward, deposit, shred via the assistant), documentation of how the assistant works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
